main_subject.wardrobe: A light-pink short-sleeve midi dress with a high rounded neckline, soft bow detail at the waist, and flowing full skirt.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Lying comfortably on her back in dense flowers, arms holding a wicker basket of blossoms near her shoulder.

composition_elements.setting: A dense botanical bed of hot-pink blossoms, fresh green leaves, and small purple accents filling the complete frame.

composition_elements.framing: Full-body overhead diagonal composition, face and dress sharp with crisp flowers around her.

technical_specs.rendering: Subtle analog grain, vivid controlled florals, warm realistic skin, correct fingers, natural joints, and no text.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical 35mm floral fashion editorial of an adult woman with neatly styled dark-brown hair, a bright joyful smile, and fresh natural glam makeup. She wears a light-pink short-sleeve midi dress with a high rounded neckline, soft bow detail at the waist, and flowing full skirt. Pose her comfortably on her back in a dense flower bed, holding a wicker basket of blossoms near one shoulder. Fill the whole frame with hot-pink flowers, green leaves, and small purple accents; add an abstract translucent pink heart-shaped ornament on the basket with no marks. Use full-body overhead diagonal framing, warm late-afternoon sun, soft leaf shadows, subtle analog grain, vivid controlled florals, warm natural skin, correct fingers and joints, and no text. No logos, watermark, or sexualized styling.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, off-shoulder mini dress, cleavage, lingerie, logo, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, AI artifacts
